notes: Designed to produce IRR >100%. Tiny CAPEX (HK$0.8M) for a software IP licensing deal with immediate large cash returns. Year-1 cashflow exceeds CAPEX. Validator must raise the 'irr_too_high' red flag and require extra justification.

input.description: License our proprietary credit-scoring algorithm to three Tier-1 banks in Southeast Asia under a 3-year exclusivity agreement. The licensing fee structure is HK$0.5M upfront per bank, then HK$0.3M per bank per year for years 2 and 3. Total investment is legal fees and integration support — no further capex. Zero marginal cost of delivery (pure IP).
